### Writing

Scientific writing is an extremely important skill to develop.

I regularly re-read this article -- everyone should read!

- The Science of Scientific Writing by Gopen and Swan ([link](https://www.americanscientist.org/blog/the-long-view/the-science-of-scientific-writing)).


### Communication

Learning how to present your research is also extremely important.

- [Trevor Campbell](https://trevorcampbell.me/) has a great talk on [How to Explain Things](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/13vwchlzQAZjjfiI3AiBC_kM-syI6GJKzbuZoLxgy1a4/edit?usp=sharing)
